title: SwarmAlpha — inspectable experiment design
evidence_type: Public design and record manifest; no new result chart
question: From a shared discussion state, how do changes in the information shown to agents change probability reports and offline Brier loss?
status: Research stopped; archived research and handoff engineering

conditions.name: CONTROL
conditions.description: The baseline continuation used in the existing fork comparison.

conditions.name: SUPPORTS
conditions.description: The implemented disclosure bundle of model-self-labeled supporting relations.

conditions.name: ATTACKS
conditions.description: The implemented disclosure bundle of model-self-labeled attacking relations.

design.qualification: The frozen analysis requires one row per condition, matching task, seed, model, resolution and Round-1 state hash; actual Round-1 probability arrays must match. Final Brier is recomputed from final agent beliefs.
design.missing: A contrast needs non-null final Brier in all three conditions. Incomplete blocks remain missing; they are not set to zero, repaired or imputed.
design.offline_measure: V_ATTACKS = Brier_CONTROL − Brier_ATTACKS; V_SUPPORTS = Brier_CONTROL − Brier_SUPPORTS; GAP_AS = Brier_SUPPORTS − Brier_ATTACKS.
design.interpretation: This is a descriptive post-hoc complete-block comparison. Model self-labels are not oracle relations, and a probability change is not a measurement of internal cognition or pure social influence.

public_record_manifest.nature: A separate publicly tracked GLM-4.6V seed-1 trajectory record slice. This is not the three-arm comparison dataset or its analysis denominator.

boundaries: No new model calls, experiment execution or result recomputation took place in this website task.

The handoff's 90-file/270-arm and 40-task figures were not adopted as independently verified public datasets. The relevant frozen-input manifest was not available through the current public repository path; raw inputs are withheld.
The current candidate submission and complete handoff package remain private. No publication, acceptance or governance-policy validation is claimed.
